Agni (Digestive Fire) and Mild Indigestion
In Ayurvedic tradition, mild digestive discomfort or heaviness is
associated with temporary low Agni (digestive fire). Traditional Lifestyle
Context: - Avoid cold, icy drinks immediately after meals. - Allow 3-4
hours between meals to permit complete digestion. - Engage in gentle
100-step post-meal walks (Shatapadi).
